name: @lakutata/template-nwjs-react
description: The NW.js template of the lakutata projects with React: the background script of NW.js is a lakutata application serving the actions of its controllers to the user interface (React, Vite, isolated in a webview), packaged into installers by lakutata package installer.
author: alex.ma

features.i18n: The messages in several languages (lakutata/com/i18n): src/locales, the language of each request
features.win7: NW.js 0.72.0, the last release running on Windows 7, 8 and 8.1 (Node.js 19.3, Chromium 109), instead of the release the template was published with
